title: JESUS, my Lord to Thee I cry

lines.text: JESUS, my Lord to Thee I cry
Unless Thou help me, I must die
Oh! bring thy free salvation nigh
And take me as I am!
Chorus:  And take me as I am (2ce)
My only plea Christ died for me
Oh take me : I am!
And take me as I am (2ce)
My only plea Christ died for me
Oh take me : I am!
Helpless I am, and full of guilt:
But yet for me thy blood was spilt,
And Thou cans’t make me what Thou wilt
And take me as I am!
Chorus:  And take me as I am...
No preparation can I make,
My best resolves I only break
Yet save me for thine own name's sake
And take me as I am!
Chorus:  And take me as I am...
Behold me Saviour at Thy feet
Deal with me as Thou seest meet
Thy work begun
Thy work complete
But take me as I am!
Chorus:  And take me as I am...
Amen.
SM(FE 80)
FATHER hark unto me
My knees bent down to Thee
Thou who doth heal and who forgives
Please harken to our pray’rs.
O God Almighty, Lord
Jehovah and my King
Thou who abides in brightest light
Thy holy name revered.
Who an the earthly King,
Jesus Emmanuel
Wonderful Lord of Jesse's root
Send forth Thy help to me.
Holy, Holy, Most High
The King and Saviour Lord
Great Omnipotent high above
Thy covenant fulfil.
In the morn hark to me
At noon, my pray’rs attend
At dusk ere the sun yet is set
Hark Lord unto my pray‘rs.
Glory to Father, God
Glory be to the Son
Glory be to the Holy Ghost
Eternal Trinity.
Amen.
